desc.T1: By the Nyquist criterion a 5 kHz signal needs sampling above 10 kHz; at 8 kHz it aliases.
desc.T2: volatile stops the compiler caching the value but does not make updates atomic; a shared counter needs interrupts disabled or an atomic operation.
desc.T3: A pull-up resistor alone sets the idle level but does not debounce; debouncing needs an RC filter, a Schmitt trigger or software filtering.
desc.T4: A higher baud rate shrinks timing margins and raises bit-error rates; it cannot make the link more reliable.
